propositions: Tickets with large text (34K–41K chars) cannot close because bounded recovery rejects contexts over 24,000 chars, blocking legitimate merged work from the closed state.
The context cap (24,000 chars) is lower than the criteria budget cap (32,000 chars), creating an incoherent bound where valid criteria sets are rejected at the context stage.
Step-budget exhaustion misreports the cause as 'install the agents extra' instead of the actual failure, because recovery errors lack the outcome field attached by the runner.
Compaction-based elision of oversized contexts silently deletes whole child tickets and their unmet criteria on epic closes, producing a signed false PASS.
The context cap must be raised to 100,000 chars with no elision, and the close-gate remedy must be selected by cause rather than exception type to fix accurate error reporting.
